notable_absence.finding: Pure JS code-sample page: a generic recursive XML-to-JSON parser (regex-based, with a 6.6.0/7.0.0 dual implementation) demonstrated inside an OnUpdate handler. The only Eventing-specific framing is boilerplate ('Requires Eventing Storage (or metadata collection) and a source collection', the Function Scope/Listen to Location/Eventing Storage/Binding configuration comment block) already captured generically by eventing:function and eventing:binding on add-eventing-functions.md - nothing new here. The 'Version 7.1+ / Version 7.0+ / Version 6.X' settings-comment block recurs verbatim (with only bucket-name substitutions) across every page in this batch; noting this as the recurring server-version-string boilerplate anomaly rather than minting anything from it.
